verdict: Paid ads have been dark since Sep 16; organic is holding steady.
narrative: Meta campaigns stopped spending on September 16 and have run at $0 for 13 consecutive days, meaning all 32 leads and the full $387.97 in spend occurred in the first half of the period. Your Google Business Profile is picking up the slack — 87 calls and 222 total actions this period show organic demand is real and active. The more pressing signal is the intake pipeline: 37 opportunities entered your system this period with zero appointments booked and zero converted, which points to a follow-up gap rather than an ads problem. Meta campaigns are being reactivated, and the appointment conversion process is being reviewed alongside that restart.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta before campaigns paused on Sep 16
cost per lead while ads were running — a solid rate while it lasted
phone calls driven by your Google Business Profile this period, with no paid support

watch_item.issue: Meta has been fully dark for 13 days, and 37 pipeline opportunities this period produced zero booked appointments.
watch_item.fix: Campaigns are being reactivated this week, and the intake-to-appointment flow is being reviewed to ensure leads that arrive are being reached and scheduled.
